desktopDevelopment.name: Desktop application development
desktopDevelopment.description: Desktop applications are standalone programs installed on users' computers. They provide a rich, responsive interface and direct access to system resources — ideal for performance‑sensitive tools, offline work, and deep OS integration.

cliDevelopment.name: CLI application development
cliDevelopment.description: Command‑line applications offer fast, scriptable interaction via terminal interfaces. They are suited for automation, developer tools, batch processing, and power‑user workflows requiring efficiency and composability.

webDevelopment.name: Web application (site) development
webDevelopment.description: Web applications and sites deliver accessible, cross‑platform experiences through browsers. They are perfect for public services, dashboards, online stores and interactive apps that require wide reach and easy updates.

apiDevelopment.name: API development
apiDevelopment.description: APIs provide programmatic access to data and business logic, enabling integration between services, mobile apps, and third‑party systems. They ensure scalable, secure and well‑documented interfaces for developers.

automationScriptsDevelopment.name: Automation scripts development
automationScriptsDevelopment.description: Automation scripts automate repetitive tasks and data transformations. They save time, reduce human error and streamline workflows across development, testing and operations.

testsDevelopment.name: Test development
testsDevelopment.description: Test development includes unit and integration tests that verify functionality and prevent regressions. Robust test suites improve reliability, speed up delivery and increase confidence in releases.

databaseCreation.name: Databases creation
databaseCreation.description: Database creation covers schema design and data modeling to store information efficiently. Well‑designed databases support performance, consistency and future scalability of applications.

serverConfiguration.name: Server and repository configuration
serverConfiguration.description: Server and repository configuration ensures reliable hosting, CI/CD pipelines and source control setup. Proper configuration enables secure deployments, automated builds and maintainable development workflows.

dockerDeployment.name: Docker deployment
dockerDeployment.description: Docker deployment packages applications into portable containers for consistent environments across development and production. Containers simplify scaling, isolation and repeatable deployments.

httpsConfiguration.name: Domain registration and TLS configuration
httpsConfiguration.description: Domain registration and TLS configuration secure websites with proper DNS setup and HTTPS certificates. This protects user data, builds trust and ensures encrypted, standards‑compliant connections.
